title: Google Maps ko traffic kaise pata chalta hai?
note: One ElevenLabs call per line, no retakes. Captions use the text without the [tags].
lines: [mischievously] Ek aadmi ne 99 phones... ek chhoti si gaadi me bhare...
[excited] aur KHAALI sadak pe, Google Maps ko traffic jam dikha diya!
Ye 2020 me Berlin me... sach me hua tha.
Kyunki Google Maps sadak ko nahi dekhta...
[whispers] wo tumhare PHONE ko dekhta hai.
Location on ho, toh tumhara phone Google ko batata rehta hai... ki tum kahan ho, aur kitni speed se chal rahe ho.
Ek sadak pe hazaaron phones. Sab tez chal rahe hain? Sadak green.
Sab reng rahe hain? Sadak... LAAL.
Ab socho... 99 phones ek saath, paidal ki speed se chal rahe hain...
[excited] Maps ko laga, yahan BHAYANKAR jam hai!
Aur wo baaki logon ko doosra raasta dikhane laga.
Ye reel us dost ko bhejo, jo hamesha bolta hai... [sarcastic] 'bas 5 minute me pahunch raha hoon!'
